question: For the function on the real line $\mathbb R$ given by $f(x)=|x|+|x+1|+e^x$, which of the following is true?

options.B: It is differentiable everywhere except at $x=0$ and $x=-1$.
options.C: It is differentiable everywhere except at $x=1/2$.
options.D: It is differentiable everywhere except at $x=-1/2$.
